title: Bhadrachalam's new Godavari bridge closed till Nov 7 for load tests
body: The new high-level bridge over the Godavari at Bhadrachalam is shut to vehicles from Oct 31 to Nov 7 for load testing. Traffic goes over the old bridge, police said.
means: Driving to Bhadrachalam this week? Expect the old bridge route
care: Plan for the old bridge if you're driving to Bhadrachalam before Nov 8.
